hotels.description: Nestled in the heart of Vilamoura's golden coast, Victoria Golf Resort & Spa offers one of the region's finest sporting retreats, effortlessly blending polished luxury with access to three of Vilamoura’s finest golf courses - Millenium, Laguna and Pinhal. Step into a haven of spacious rooms and suites, sapphire pools and manicured fairways. Pop the bubbly in a poolside cabana, let the little ones run wild at the kids' club, then steal away to Victoria Spa where ancient wellness rituals work their magic. Beyond your doorstep, Vilamoura unfolds like a love letter to the good life - Roman whispers in ancient stone, yacht-dotted marinas and that irresistible Algarve allure.
